concerns.text: The plan applies a Two‑One‑Sided Tests (TOST) equivalence test and a two‑sample t‑test assuming the 30 seed runs for the baseline and the constrained conditions are independent. Because the same random seeds, data shuffling, and model initialisation are used across conditions, the observations are paired (correlated). Using independent‑sample tests ignores this dependence, inflating Type I error risk and mis‑estimating power. The methodology should employ paired‑sample equivalents (e.g., paired‑difference TOST or paired t‑test) or explicitly decorrelate the runs.
